title: Texture Lab Review Pack 01 — R1/R7/R8 canonical POC
scope: All 12 canonical RT-POC-01 textures; prioritization controls human review order only.

comparison_model.B: Deterministic Enhanced reference using the per-texture enhanced_reference method
comparison_model.C: Eligible AI Restored and/or AI Recreated candidate evidence when a staged run exists and passes its normal evidence gates
comparison_model.note: C may contain zero, one or two AI candidates according to the existing AI review policy. Missing AI output never changes A/B source readiness.

priority_levels.P1: Hero/problematic or highest-information texture; review first.
priority_levels.P2: Representative material/architecture/object texture; review after P1.
priority_levels.P3: Lower-risk coverage texture; review after P1/P2.

safe_upscale.purpose: Use deterministic Enhanced as the default improvement baseline; AI must beat it without reducing fidelity.

ai_recreation_candidate.purpose: Run the full Classic/Enhanced/AI comparison because learned reconstruction may add useful material/artwork detail.

conservative.purpose: Semantic, alpha, text, puzzle, transparency or geometry risk dominates; preserve Classic/Enhanced truth and treat AI as strictly constrained or disabled.

dimensions.label: Fidelity to original
dimensions.anchor_5: Preserves authored composition, geometry and identity.

dimensions.label: Readability / detail
dimensions.anchor_5: Clearer useful detail at gameplay scale without false structure.

dimensions.label: Material believability
dimensions.anchor_5: Plausible material detail consistent with source.

dimensions.label: Atmosphere / period feel
dimensions.anchor_1: Visually out of place for Azrael's Tear.
dimensions.anchor_5: Preserves the original visual character and mood.

dimensions.label: Tiling / seam safety
dimensions.anchor_5: No worse than Classic; required repeat/seam boundaries remain safe.

dimensions.label: Semantic / gameplay safety
dimensions.anchor_1: Changes symbols, puzzle cues, openings, text or object meaning.

dimensions.label: Artifact cleanliness
dimensions.anchor_1: Strong ringing, false edges, hallucinated microdetail or anatomy errors.

dimensions.label: Alpha / transparency safety
dimensions.anchor_5: Source alpha/transparency policy is preserved exactly where applicable.
